SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, KEY_3 AS REVISION FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRKFNT0001' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL GROUP BY TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.STATUS AS STATUS, A.ATOB_DATE AS ADD_DATE, A.ATOB_TIME AS ADD_TIME, A.QUOTATION_NO||A.QUOTATION_SEQ AS QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ AS SEQ, A.REVISION AS REVISION_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, REPLACE(C.IRS_NO,'-','') AS SELLER, C.COM_NAME_LOC AS SELLER_COMPANY_NAME, ( SELECT NVL(USER_NAME_LOC,' ') FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = B.AGENT AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS SELLER_NAME, ( SELECT NVL(PHONE_NUMBER,' ') FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = B.AGENT AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS SELLER_TEL, TO_CHAR(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,'999999999999.00') AS UNIT_PRICE, SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_SINGLE_BYTE(RTRIM(A.ATOB_REMARK )),' '),1,300) AS REMARK FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B, ICOMCMPY C, ICOMTRXL D WHERE D.DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND D.TARGET = A.BUYER AND D.KEY_1 = A.QUOTATION_NO AND D.KEY_2 = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND D.KEY_3 = A.REVISION AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO= B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ= B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.AGENT = C.COM_CODE AND D.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND D.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND D.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND D.KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND TRIM(D.KEY_9) IS NULL
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'D', KEY_8 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_8 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL
